name: Fertilizer & Phosphate Value Chain
who: Supplying fertilizer producers, acid plants, blenders and distributors across South and Southeast Asia.

products.name: Sulphur
products.short: Granular, prilled and lump sulphur, 99.5% min. purity
products.lead: Elemental sulphur in granular, prilled and lump form, produced to international standards for sulphuric acid, fertilizer, refining and industrial users.
products.title: Sulphur (Granular / Prills / Lumps)

products.name: Sulphuric Acid
products.short: H₂SO₄ 98% min. for phosphate and ammonium sulphate production
products.lead: High-purity sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) produced to GB/T 534-2002 and other global quality norms, for phosphate fertilizer, metal leaching and chemical manufacture.
products.title: Sulphuric Acid

products.name: Phosphoric Acid
products.short: Merchant-grade 52–54% P₂O₅ and technical 85% H₃PO₄
products.lead: Phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) is the key intermediate between rock phosphate and finished fertilizers such as MAP, DAP and TSP. We supply merchant-grade acid for fertilizer producers and purified technical grade for industrial users.
products.title: Phosphoric Acid

products.name: Rock Phosphate
products.lead: Essential resource for agriculture and industry.
products.title: Rock Phosphate

products.name: Mono Ammonium Phosphate (MAP)

products.lead: High-analysis nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizer.
products.title: Mono Ammonium Phosphate (MAP)

products.name: Diammonium Phosphate (DAP)
products.short: 18-46-0 hard, free-flowing granules
products.lead: Balanced crop nutrition for strong early growth.
products.title: Diammonium Phosphate (DAP)

products.name: Urea
products.short: 46% N, prilled and granular
products.lead: Powering agricultural productivity with precision nutrition.
products.title: Urea

products.name: Ammonium Sulphate
products.short: 21% N, 24% S, crystalline and granular
products.lead: Ammonium sulphate ((NH₄)₂SO₄) is a nitrogen-and-sulphur fertilizer and industrial chemical valued for purity, stability and versatility — promoting healthy growth, chlorophyll formation and protein synthesis.
products.title: Ammonium Sulphate

name: Metallurgical Reductants
who: Reductants for NPI, ferroalloy, steel and foundry producers, with a focus on Indonesia’s nickel smelting sector.

products.name: Semi Coke
products.short: Fixed carbon 80–88%, for RKEF nickel smelting
products.lead: Semi coke (兰炭) is a critical input in nickel ferroalloy production, particularly the Rotary Kiln–Electric Furnace (RKEF) process widely used across Indonesia. Acting as both reducing agent and energy source, it enables efficient conversion of nickel ore into nickel pig iron (NPI) for stainless steel.
products.title: Semi Coke

products.name: Metallurgical Coke
products.short: Fixed carbon 85–92%, for blast furnaces and foundries
products.lead: Metallurgical coke is produced by high-temperature carbonisation of coking coal. In blast-furnace ironmaking it acts as fuel, reductant and structural support, keeping the furnace permeable for gas flow. Its strength, low impurities and high carbon content are essential for stable, efficient steel production.
products.title: Metallurgical Coke

products.name: Calcined Pet Coke
products.short: Fixed carbon 98.5% min., carbon raiser and anode grade
products.lead: Calcined petroleum coke (CPC) is green pet coke heated to around 1,200–1,350°C to drive off moisture and volatiles, leaving a high-purity, electrically conductive carbon. It is the main carbon source for aluminium anodes and a widely used carbon raiser in steel and foundry melting.
products.title: Calcined Pet Coke

products.name: Graphite Pet Coke
products.short: Graphitized, low-sulphur carbon raiser for steel and ductile iron
products.lead: Graphitized petroleum coke (GPC) is calcined pet coke treated at around 2,800–3,000°C, converting its carbon into a graphite structure. With very low sulphur and nitrogen, it dissolves quickly in molten metal and is the preferred carbon raiser for ductile iron and high-grade steel.
products.title: Graphite Pet Coke

name: Industrial Chemicals
who: Supplying chemical, glass, detergent, pulp & paper, alumina and water-treatment industries.

products.name: Methanol
products.short: IMPCA-grade, 99.85% min. purity
products.lead: Methanol (CH₃OH) is one of the world’s most traded chemicals — a building block for formaldehyde, acetic acid and olefins, a fuel and fuel additive, and a fast-growing low-carbon marine fuel.
products.title: Methanol

products.name: Caustic Soda
products.short: NaOH flakes, pearls and lye (32% / 48–50%)
products.lead: Caustic soda (sodium hydroxide, NaOH) is one of the most essential industrial chemicals — a strong alkali for chemical synthesis, neutralisation and pH control.
products.title: Caustic Soda

products.name: Soda Ash
products.short: Na₂CO₃ 99.2% min., dense and light grades
products.lead: Sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃), or soda ash, is a versatile alkali used in glass, detergents, chemicals and water treatment.
products.title: Soda Ash

name: Petroleum & Oilfield Products
who: Supplying road contractors, waterproofing manufacturers, lubricant blenders and drilling contractors.

products.name: Bitumen
products.short: Penetration, viscosity, performance and oxidised grades
products.lead: Penetration, viscosity, performance and oxidised bitumen grades for road construction, roofing, waterproofing and industrial use — packed to suit every route to site.
products.title: Bitumen

products.name: Base Oil
products.short: Group I / II, SN150 and SN500
products.lead: Base oils are the main component of finished lubricants, making up 70–90% of most engine, gear and industrial oils. We supply solvent-refined Group I and hydro-processed Group II base oils in the two most widely blended viscosity grades, SN150 and SN500.
products.title: Base Oil (Group I/II, SN150, SN500)

products.name: Barite Powder
products.short: API 13A drilling grade, SG 4.1–4.2
products.lead: Barite (barium sulphate, BaSO₄) is a high-density, chemically inert mineral essential to drilling, chemical and manufacturing applications.
products.title: Barite Powder

products.name: Bentonite
products.short: Sec 9, 10 and 11 grades for drilling and foundry
products.lead: Bentonite is a natural clay composed mainly of montmorillonite, known for exceptional water absorption and swelling. We supply powder and lump forms, grades Sec 9, 10 and 11, for drilling, foundry and environmental applications.
products.title: Bentonite

name: Biomass & Renewable Fuels

products.name: Wood Chips

products.lead: Wood chips from plantation-grown eucalyptus, acacia and pine in Indonesia and the wider region, supplied as fibre grade for pulp and panel-board mills and as fuel grade for biomass boilers and industrial furnaces.
products.title: Wood Chips (Eucalyptus / Pine / Acacia)

products.name: Coconut Shell Charcoal
products.short: Fixed carbon 75% min., activated-carbon feedstock
products.lead: Charcoal carbonised from coconut shells — a renewable, high-carbon, low-ash material and the preferred feedstock for coconut-shell activated carbon.
products.title: Coconut Shell Charcoal
